If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed participant to finish as runner-up of Liga Nacional (Guatemala) for the 2026 season per the rules of Liga Nacional (Guatemala) (e.g., the participant is eliminated), the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams are declared as second-place finishers, this market will resolve in favor of the team whose listed name comes first alphabetically.

If this event is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or a runner-up has not been declared within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official information from the Liga Nacional (Guatemala); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
